race.title: Edinburgh Rugby 1872 Cup Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: SCOTS POET looks the percentage call as he bids for win number 5 this year. Front-running Nobotheratall is the main threat in a tricky 6-runner handicap, with Gemini Man very much respected on his course form from last winter. SCOTS POET NOBOTHERATALL (IRE) GEMINI MAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Saint Polo (2/1), Nobotheratall (11/4), Scots Poet (10/3), Bruce Banner (6/1), Gemini Man (8/1), Shooting (25/1)
